fields.description: The Arthouse brings apartments and two sky villas to Saadiyat Cultural District. Three residential buildings share creative and social spaces, with interiors by DiLeonardo and a rooftop garden overlooking the district.

overview: The residential concept borrows from private members’ clubs, but its spaces are intended for residents. Cultural institutions including Louvre Abu Dhabi and Guggenheim Abu Dhabi form the surrounding district. Apartment orientation determines the actual outlook; the project-wide description is not a guarantee for an individual home.
research.locationNote: Located on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi’s Cultural District. Aldar places the homes near the museums and the retail and leisure spaces of Saadiyat Grove.
research.priceNote: Property Finder records AED 3.3m at launch and currently marks developer stock sold out. This does not establish today’s resale price or availability. Obtain a dated quotation and cost breakdown.
research.paymentNote: The reviewed launch schedule totals 65% before handover and 35% at handover. Several original dates have passed; a current purchase needs the outstanding balance and contractual schedule.
research.handoverNote: May 2028 is the published estimate in the reviewed sales presentation and Property Finder. It is not evidence of completed construction or a guaranteed possession date.

facts.label: Announced scale
facts.value: Aldar announced 281 homes across three buildings, including two sky villas, in July 2024. This is the launch count, not current availability.

facts.label: Design and sustainability
facts.value: Interiors are by DiLeonardo. Aldar stated targets of 3 Pearl Estidama and 2-star Fitwel; these are targets, not verified awarded certifications.

facts.label: Representative drawings
facts.value: The sales presentation shows a 95 sq m one-bedroom A1, 147 sq m two-bedroom A1 and 256 sq m three-bedroom A1 with maid’s room. Compare the exact drawing and outdoor-area treatment for the selected unit.
